items.title: 🦅Rate-Hike Bets Keep Climbing
items.summary: Traders have further ramped up their expectations for interest rate-hikes after a jam-packed 24 hours that brought strong economic data, higher oil prices and comments from a Fed governor backing further rate increases.

items.title: Record High UNI Sits on Exchanges: Sell Pressure Ahead, or Are Whales Right?
items.summary: Uniswap exchange reserves hit a record 113.9 million UNI as whales withdraw tokens and stock token deposits climbs.

items.title: US Dollar Price Forecast: Strong U.S. Data Lifts DXY as EUR/USD and GBP/USD Weaken
items.summary: Strong U.S. data and hawkish Fed expectations support DXY as EUR/USD and GBP/USD remain pressured below key technical resistance.

items.title: What’s Driving the Jump in U.S. Treasury Yields?
items.summary: Ten-year Treasury yields hit 5.1% yesterday. The 10-year yield rose almost 0.15 percentage point, to 5.113%, its highest closing yield since July 12, 2007. Oil’s price rise accompanied firming conviction that the Fed will be hiking again.

items.title: BitMEX Has Shut Down: Where Do Its Traders Go Now?
items.summary: After 11 years, the exchange that invented the perpetual swap contract has gone dark, leaving its remaining traders scrambling and a $495 million lawsuit from Celsius's bankruptcy estate casting a long shadow over its founders.

items.title: Bitcoin Cash Rallies 30% Following CME Futures Announcement
items.summary: CME Group just triggered a 30% spike in Bitcoin Cash, but the last three coins to get the same futures announcement lost over a third of their value before trading even began. A surprise Grayscale filing may be the only thing standing between BCH and the same fate.
